item.description: A very old friend of mine died a couple of years ago. I had lunch with him last week. So, overall, he seems to be doing much better.

item.title: Joel, You Are Going to Get Cancelled.
item.description: My Chief of Staff informs me I am in danger of being cancelled. My offense: I wrote that women’s poop stinks. Apparently this was controversial.

item.title: Changing the World, “One” Hat at a Time
item.description: A young pro golfer asked me to sponsor him on the PGA Tour. Everyone thought that was hilarious. So what exactly are we laughing at?

item.description: A list of sayings that felt less like inspirational wisdom and more like somebody had been secretly following me around for decades taking notes.

item.title: Apple, Psyllium & the Complete Collapse of Western Civilization
item.description: I bought a MacBook. At almost exactly the same time, in an entirely unrelated act of spectacularly bad judgment, I added psyllium to my diet.

item.title: Black Plastic
item.description: A meal-prep place with a beautiful sourcing story, a nutrition person, and a transparency pitch — serving everything in black plastic.

item.title: I Trust AI. I'm Starting Not to Trust the People Using It.

item.description: Another travel day. More craziness. And, as I write this, the airplane hasn't even left the gate.

item.title: There Are Some Things We Were Never Meant to Know
item.description: I would like to address one of the great architectural mistakes of our time: the unisex restaurant bathroom.

item.title: Stop Watching. Start F@cking Creating.
item.description: At some point, we became a civilization of spectators. We have been handed superpowers and we are using them to watch strangers organize their refrigerators.
